newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas shrs edge up, buck 6-day losing streak.
newsitem.headline: Caracas shrs edge up, buck 6-day losing streak.

text.p: Shares prices on the Caracas Stock Exchange edged up, reversing six sessions of falling prices in thin trading as investors took cautious positions, brokers said.
The market's 19-share index slipped 0.69 percent to 4,588.43, as 20 stocks rose, nine fell and five closed unchanged.
"Prices showed more resistance and there were some buying orders for leading stocks," one broker said.
Volume was again light, however, with just 1.587 billion bolivars ($3.3 million) changing hands, the exchange said.
